'''Watcher''' can refer to the following:

== People ==
* [[Watcher of the Seals]] - one of the titles of the Amyrlin Seat.
* [[The Watchers Over the Waves]] - a group of people who anticipated the return of [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s armies.
* [[Moridin|The Watcher]] - A term for Moridin when he was watching [[Sammael]] and [[Graendal]].

== Chapter titles ==
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 17|Watchers and Hunters]]'' - the seventeeth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 22|Watchers]]'' - the twenty-second chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
